features: Unchanged 96 baseline magnetic summaries; no HARP IDs, years or evaluation errors as features

teacher.mining_period: Final two calendar years of the outer training period, ending before outer calibration year
teacher.purging: Teacher prediction_end <= mining_start; mining observation_start >= mining_start; remove mining HARPs present in teacher fit
teacher.scores: Raw teacher probability; teacher trained exclusively before mining observations
teacher.eligibility: Known negative outer-training windows in the mining period
teacher.selection: Sort eligible negatives by score descending, then forecast_time ascending, then HARP ascending; take ceil(0.10 * eligible_count)

student.ensemble: Replace only XGBoost in the fixed 0.45 logistic / 0.55 XGBoost blend; logistic arm unchanged

uniform_control: All outer-training negative windows receive 1 + 2 * hard_negative_count / outer_training_negative_count; positives retain weight 1. Total negative weight matches the hard-negative arm.
calibration: Refit sigmoid on unchanged outer calibration year separately for each student; select each ensemble threshold at recall >=0.95 on calibration and freeze before evaluation.
skips: Preserve outer-fold skip rules. If teacher lacks both classes or eligible mining negatives are empty, mark both new arms unavailable; never silently substitute baseline.
selection: No tuning on evaluation labels; report all three fixed arms and all eligible years
acceptance: No automatic promotion. Require strictly higher precision and recall >=0.95 in every comparable positive evaluation year; AP must not decrease and Brier/log loss must not increase per year versus baseline. Review paired HARP uncertainty and both controls; improvement over uniform control is needed to attribute benefit to targeted mining.
zero_positive_years: Report false positives and FPR; recall remains undefined.

uncertainty.scope: Conditional on trained models and frozen thresholds; no independence claim across years

limitations: Post-hoc development hypothesis informed by historical evaluation errors; not an independent test.
Weighting can reduce recall and need not improve ranking or probability calibration.
Missingness associations are descriptive and may reflect region composition; no causal quality claim.
No label changes, difficult-region exclusions or retrospective alert suppression.
